mapper.select: SELECT h.id AS highlight_id, s.id AS session_id, s.title AS session_title, s.started_at AS session_started_at, t.started_at AS trigger_started_at, h.start_ms, h.end_ms, r.output_path AS recording_path, r.base_wall_clock, r.base_timecode_ms FROM highlights h JOIN reports rep ON rep.id = h.report_id JOIN broadcast_sessions s ON s.id = rep.session_id JOIN recordings r ON r.session_id = s.id LEFT JOIN triggers t ON t.id = h.trigger_id WHERE s.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND h.clip_status = 'PENDING' AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND r.output_path IS NOT NULL AND r.base_wall_clock IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, h.start_ms ASC

SELECT h.id AS highlight_id, s.id AS session_id, h.clip_status, h.clip_url, h.thumbnail_url FROM highlights h JOIN reports rep ON rep.id = h.report_id JOIN broadcast_sessions s ON s.id = rep.session_id WHERE h.id = #{highlightId} AND s.streamer_id = #{streamerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE highlights SET clip_url = #{clipPath}, thumbnail_url = #{thumbnailPath}, clip_status = 'UPLOADED', clip_failed_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{highlightId} AND clip_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE highlights SET clip_attempts = clip_attempts + 1, clip_failed_reason = #{reason}, clip_status = CASE WHEN clip_attempts + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END WHERE id = #{highlightId} AND clip_status = 'PENDING'
